description: This file defines a TypeScript module for managing iMessage conversation bindings, including creating managers, binding/unbinding conversations, and handling session binding adapters.

classes.name: IMessageConversationBindingRecord
classes.description: Represents a record of an iMessage conversation binding with details like account ID, conversation ID, target kind, session key, and activity timestamps.

classes.name: IMessageConversationBindingManager
classes.description: Interface for managing iMessage conversation bindings, including methods to get, list, bind, touch, unbind, and stop bindings.

classes.name: IMessageConversationBindingsState
classes.description: Internal state holding managers and bindings maps for conversation management.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves the current internal state, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: resolveBindingKey
methods.description: Creates a unique key for a conversation binding based on account ID and conversation ID.

methods.name: toSessionBindingTargetKind
methods.description: Converts raw target kind string to BindingTargetKind type.

methods.name: toSessionBindingRecord
methods.description: Transforms a conversation binding record into a SessionBindingRecord with computed expiration times.

methods.name: createIMessageConversationBindingManager
methods.description: Factory function to create and initialize a conversation binding manager for a given account and configuration.
